SELECT FROM bike_sales_order orders JOIN bike_pi_order_link ol ON ol.order_id = orders.id JOIN bike_pi original ON original.series_id = ol.series_id AND original.customer_id = orders.customer_id AND (orders.agent_id IS NULL OR original.agent_id = orders.agent_id) JOIN bike_pi_logistics logistics ON logistics.pi_id = original.id WHERE orders.id = #{orderId}
AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bike_stock_out_batch_item item JOIN bike_stock_out_record shipment ON shipment.id = item.stock_out_id WHERE item.batch_id = logistics.stock_out_batch_id AND shipment.order_id = orders.id AND shipment.status = 'COMPLETED' ) OR (logistics.stock_out_batch_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_order_link other WHERE other.series_id = ol.series_id AND other.order_id != orders.id )) ) ORDER BY logistics.shipped_at DESC, logistics.id DESC
